definition: [ כָּלֶה ] adjective failing with desire, longing , only feminine plural וְעֵינֶיךָ ראֹוֺת וְכָלוֺת אֲלֵיהֶם Deut 28:32 while thine eyes look and fail longingly for them (compare verb כלה Qal 2 b , and כִּלָּיוֺן below)
